input.content: 1. `app/packages/core/src/repository.ts`, lines 44-62 — The new `Writes` interface and its comment were inserted between the `Repository` doc comment and `Repository` itself. The sentences "The operations every D1 store shares… `remove` marks the row" now sit above `Writes` and describe `Repository`, and `Writes` has a comment that begins mid-block. Cost: a misleading comment on both types. Fix: put `Writes` and its comment above the `Repository` comment, leaving the `Repository` comment attached to `Repository`. 2. `app/packages/database/src/repository.ts`, ~line 274 — The returned object exposes the same value under two names, `statements` and `writes: statements`. `codes.ts`, `materials.ts` and `users.ts` use `statements`; `hands.ts` and the new core ports use `writes`. Cost: two names for one thing; a reader has to find out they are identical. Fix: pick one name (`writes`, which matches the core `Writes` type) and rename the existing uses. 3. `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/AdminSessionRail.tsx` (`renderNode`) and `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/AllSessions.tsx` (`renderNode`) — Both contain the same block: `railLook`, `RailNode`, the `check` icon when `done`, and the `star` icon with `fill-current max-[600px]:size-5` when `live`. Cost: a change to the node rendering has to be made twice. Fix: extract a `SessionRailNode` component that takes `session` and `featuredPosition`, and use it in both places. 4. `app/apps/web/src/routes/_app/index.tsx`, `routes/_app/aula.tsx`, `routes/_app/admin/index.tsx` — Each repeats `list.find((session) => session.featured)` inline, while `useFeaturedSession` (admin only) wraps the same predicate through `select`. Cost: "the featured session" is defined in four places. Fix: export one `findFeatured` from the sessions feature and use it everywhere. The student side, which uses `useSessions`, can use it too. 5. `app/apps/web/src/features/questions/FeaturedQuestions.tsx` — It repeats the structure of `StudentQuestions`: `useQuestions`, sort by votes, skeleton with `questionExamples` and read-only `VoteToggle`, `QuestionForm`, `QuestionList` with `VoteToggle` and `DeleteOwnQuestion`. Only the limit of three and the toggle differ. Cost: two components to keep in step for the list, the skeleton and the row actions. Fix: let `StudentQuestions` take an optional list transform or limit, or extract the shared skeleton and row renderers. 6. `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/EnabledSwitch.tsx`, `FeaturedSwitch.tsx`, `EnableSessionDialog.tsx`, `app/apps/web/src/features/questions/FeaturedQuestionsSwitch.tsx` — Four hand-written `` blocks (the base had one, in `EnabledSwitch`). Cost: markup and accessibility attributes are copied four times with different classes. Fix: a shared `SwitchButton` in `ui/` that takes `label`, `on`, `disabled` and `onClick`. 7. `app/apps/web/src/features/sessions/FeaturedSwitch.tsx` — It renders three mutually exclusive branches (featured, not featured with another one featured, not featured with none), each calling `toggle` with a different handler, and filters them with three separate `session.featured` conditions. Cost: the branching is hard to read, and the same shape is repeated in `EnabledSwitch`. Fix: decide once which variant applies, either a `ConfirmAction` with its props or a direct handler, and render a single `toggle` or a single `ConfirmAction`. 8. `app/packages/core/src/polls/polls.ts`, `isFeatured` — This new local helper re-reads the session to check `featured`, but `featuredSession` in `visible-session.ts` was added in the same diff to express the same rule, and `polls.ts` also uses it. Cost: two paths decide "is this session featured". Fix: build the check on the shared helper in `visible-session.ts`, for example `Effect.isSuccess(featuredSession(sessions, id))`.
